settings.name_in_paper: Online conformal prediction beyond feedback / OCPWF partial monitoring game
unmapped: Actions are |M| finite prediction thresholds plus a 'query' action; prediction actions yield no observation, query yields zero reward but reveals the label (hence rewards of all thresholds)
Reward is the auxiliary reward R(m,t)=1-m(1-beta) if y_t in Gamma_C(x_t,m), else 0; regret compared to best fixed threshold in M
Inputs x_t observed each round from an oblivious data stream; black-box classifier C given
settings.definition_quote: On each round $t$, the learner observes the input $x_t$ and returns an action $a_t \in \mathcal A = \mathcal{P}(\mathcal{Y)} \cup \{\texttt{query}\}$ ... the learner receives an observation $\omega_t$ ... where $\omega_t = y_t$ if $a_t = \texttt{query}$, and otherwise $\omega_t$ is a null observation $\bot$.

source.label: thm:simple_learner_regret
source.quote: For any data stream $z^T$ and classifier $C$, and any $\eta \in (0,1]$ and $\epsilon \in (0,0.5]$, the expected regret of Algorithm~\ref{algorithm:OCP_with_queries} is at most $\frac{\ln(|M|)}{\eta} + \epsilon \cdot T + \left(\frac{\eta}{\epsilon}\right) \cdot T$.

results.notes: Restated as Theorem 5 in the appendix. Rewards are deterministic given the oblivious stream, so the expectation is over the algorithm's randomness only.

source.label: thm:simple_learner_regret
source.quote: If we set $\epsilon = T^{-1/3}$ and $\eta = T^{-2/3} \cdot \sqrt{\ln(|M|)}$ then this simplifies to $T^{2/3} \cdot (2 \sqrt{\ln(|M|)} + 1)$.

results.notes: Expected query fraction is T^{-1/3}. The validity constraints on eta and epsilon are carried over from the first part of the theorem. Theorem 10 in the appendix gives the same bound for the fixed-rate special case.

source.label: corollary:coverage_rate_bound
source.quote: On any data stream $z^T$ and for any classifier $C$, the coverage rate of Algorithm~\ref{algorithm:OCP_with_queries} satisfies $\mathbb{E}\left[p_{\text{cover}}\right] \geq \beta - \left(\frac{2 \sqrt{\ln(|M|)} + 1}{\sqrt[3]{T}}\right)$ if $\eta = T^{-2/3} \cdot \sqrt{\ln|M|} \leq 1$ and $\epsilon = T^{-1/3} \leq 0.5$.

results.notes: Recorded as an upper bound on the coverage deficit beta_base - E[p_cover]. Restated as Corollary 3 in the appendix and recovered as a special case of Corollary 6.

source.label: thm:high_probability_bound
source.quote: For any $\delta \in (0,1)$, if $\epsilon = T^{-1/3} \leq 0.5$ and $\eta = T^{-2/3} \cdot \sqrt{\ln(|M|)} \leq 1$, then with probability at least $1-\delta$, the regret of Algorithm~\ref{algorithm:OCP_with_queries} is at most ...

results.notes: Realised regret, holding with probability at least 1-delta.

source.quote: For any $\epsilon \in (0,0.5]$, $\eta \in (0,1]$, and $\delta \in (0,1)$, we have that the regret of Algorithm~\ref{algorithm:OCP_with_queries} is at most $2\left(\frac{n}{\epsilon}\right) + \epsilon T + \eta T + \left(\frac{\eta}{\epsilon}\right)T + \left(\frac{\eta}{\epsilon^2}\right)n + \frac{\ln(|M|)}{\eta}$ with probability at least $1-\delta$, where $n = 2\sqrt{\epsilon T\ln(3/\delta)} + 2\ln(3/\delta)$.

results.notes: General-parameter version of Theorem 3, given in the appendix.

source.quote: If $\epsilon = T^{-1/3} \leq 0.5$ and $\eta = T^{-2/3} \cdot \sqrt{\ln(|M|)} \leq 1$, then for any $\delta \in (0, 1)$ we have that with probability at least $1-\delta$, the coverage rate $p_\text{cover}$ of Algorithm~\ref{algorithm:OCP_with_queries} is at least ...

results.notes: High-probability upper bound on the coverage deficit beta - p_cover. Restated as Corollary 4 in the appendix.

symbols.kappa_k: E[max(2*sigma_target - theta_k^* - 1, 0)], the clipping error term, where theta_k^* is the coverage estimate at the start of the last period

tuning: k >= 2 periods with n_i = n_1 2^{i-2} for i>=2
beta_1 = sigma, beta_i = clip_[0,1](2 sigma - theta_i^*)

source.label: thm:adaptive_ocpq_coverage_bound
source.quote: Suppose that we run the adaptive version of \texttt{OCPQ} with target coverage $\sigma \in [0,1]$ over $k \geq 2$ time periods whose lengths are $n_1 \dots n_k$, with $n_i = n_1 \cdot 2^{i-2}$ for $i \geq 2$ ... We then have that $\mathbb{E}[p_{cover}] \geq \sigma - \left(\frac{1}{2}\right)^{2/3}\cdot\left(\frac{2\sqrt{\ln(|M|)} + 1}{\sqrt[3]{T}}\right) - \frac{1}{2} \cdot \mathbb{E}\left[\max\left(2\sigma -\theta_{k}^\star - 1, 0\right)\right]$.

results.notes: Upper bound on the coverage deficit sigma_target - E[p_cover]. Theorem 8 in the appendix generalises this to arbitrary period lengths. The clipping term is bounded separately in Theorem 9 and Corollary 5, which were not recorded.

symbols.sum_q: E[sum_t q_t], expected total query probability

source.quote: For any data stream $\xi$ and classifier $C$, any $\eta\in(0,1]$, and any predictable sequence of query probabilities $q_t\in(0,0.5]$, the expected regret of Algorithm~\ref{algorithm:OCP_with_queries} with the auxiliary reward is at most $\frac{\ln(|M|)}{\eta} +\mathbb{E}\left[\sum_{t=1}^Tq_t\right] +\eta\,\mathbb{E}\left[\sum_{t=1}^T\frac{1}{q_t}\right]$.

results.notes: Variant of OCPQ with an adaptive query rate. With q_t = epsilon it reduces to Theorem 1. Corollary 6 gives the matching coverage bound (not recorded separately).

conditions: beta < 1 (if beta = 1, zero regret is achievable)

source.label: prop:OCPPF_is_a_hard_game
source.quote: The optimal worst-case expected regret in OCPWF is $\Theta(T^{2/3})$, unless $\beta = 1$, in which case we get 0 regret by picking $a_t = 1$ every round.

results.notes: Only the lower side of the Theta statement is recorded (the upper side is r2). The proof applies Theorem 1 of Lattimore & Szepesvari (2018): the game is globally but not locally observable.
